# tikoci crossref

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-crossref.ts; do not edit. Change data/repo-config.ts
     or a house skill's description, then run `bun run generate:crossref`. -->

The map of the tikoci org for agents developing its repos: which repo is the
place to look for a topic, which repos use another's packages or published
files, and which house skill covers a task. It is generated from
`data/repo-config.ts` and the house skills' descriptions in [tikoci.github.io](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io),
and a test there fails when this file is stale.

## How to use it

- **Reference it by URL**,
  <https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-crossref/SKILL.md>, instead of copying it into a
  repo: unlike the other house skills it changes whenever a repo does.
- **Before changing another repo, read its `AGENTS.md`**: the rows below say
  where to look, not how that repo works.
- **Do not restate this map** in an `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or user-level
  notes. A missing or wrong row is a PR against
  [`data/repo-config.ts`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io/blob/main/data/repo-config.ts):
  `owns` and `category` for a repo, `RELATIONSHIPS` with a `verifiedNote` for a
  dependency, `CROSSREF_HEADLINES` for the description.
- **Machine facts stay local**: where checkouts live and what is registered
  on one machine belong in the operator's agent notes ([tikoci-house](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-house/SKILL.md)).
- **Using the tools rather than developing them?** Start at
  <https://tikoci.dev/llms.txt> and the `routeros-*` skills.

## Repos

Public repos with an entry in `data/repo-config.ts`, grouped as on
<https://tikoci.dev/>. The first topic is the repo's role.

### AI & Agents

| Repo | Place to look for | Packages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`bench-routeros-tools`](https://github.com/tikoci/bench-routeros-tools) | benchmarks of agent RouterOS tooling: MCPs, skills, retrieval | - |
| [`rosetta`](https://github.com/tikoci/rosetta) | RouterOS documentation search as an MCP server (SQLite FTS); the `ros-help.db` docs database: pages, commands, devices, changelogs | npm `@tikoci/rosetta` |
| [`routeros-muse`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-muse) | an agent workspace and web UI for RouterOS networks (preview) | npm `@tikoci/routeros-muse` |
| [`routeros-skills`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-skills) | public `routeros-*` agent skills: using RouterOS and tikoci tools | - |

| [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | RouterOS device access as a CLI and library: REST, native API, SSH, MAC-Telnet, MNDP; checking a RouterOS command before it runs (`centrs explain`); the WinBox address book (CDB) and router credentials | npm `@tikoci/centrs` |

| [`m2ir`](https://github.com/tikoci/m2ir) | RouterOS binary protocols and formats as a YAML schema: M2 (`nv::message`), WinBox, CDB, MNDP, RoMON, the Dude store | - |

## Dependencies

Verified uses only: each row was checked in the using repo's code, and the
evidence names the file. A package is an npm dependency; an artifact is a
file the provider publishes (a release, a Pages file, a pinned blob). The
[project map](https://tikoci.dev/project-map.html) also shows associations,
which claim no use.

| Provides | Used by | Kind | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | [`routeros-muse`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-muse) | package | routeros-muse's package.json depends on @tikoci/centrs@next (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`fat-chr`](https://github.com/tikoci/fat-chr) | [`mikropkl`](https://github.com/tikoci/mikropkl) | artifact | mikropkl's Manifests/chr.x86_64.apple.pkl downloads the fat-chr release image (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`lsp-routeros-ts`](https://github.com/tikoci/lsp-routeros-ts) | [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | artifact | centrs pins lsp-routeros-ts's test-data/corpus.sqlite by commit and SHA-256 for its explain census (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`quickchr`](https://github.com/tikoci/quickchr) | [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | package | centrs's CHR integration tests use @tikoci/quickchr (devDependency; surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`quickchr`](https://github.com/tikoci/quickchr) | [`m2ir`](https://github.com/tikoci/m2ir) | package | m2ir's probe harnesses boot CHRs with @tikoci/quickchr (devDependency; surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`quickchr`](https://github.com/tikoci/quickchr) | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) | package | restraml's scripts/deep-inspect-multi-arch.ts boots its per-architecture CHRs with @tikoci/quickchr (devDependency; surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`quickchr`](https://github.com/tikoci/quickchr) | [`routeros-muse`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-muse) | package | routeros-muse's package.json depends on @tikoci/quickchr@next (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) | [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | artifact | centrs's scripts/restraml-trees.ts pins restraml command trees for the explain catalog (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) | [`rosetta`](https://github.com/tikoci/rosetta) | artifact | rosetta's src/restraml.ts reads inspect.json per version from restraml's Pages site (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) | [`vscode-tikbook`](https://github.com/tikoci/vscode-tikbook) | artifact | vscode-tikbook's src/app-yaml.ts loads the /app YAML JSON schemas from restraml's Pages site (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`rosetta`](https://github.com/tikoci/rosetta) | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) | artifact | restraml's OpenAPI workflows download rosetta's latest ros-help.db.gz to add documentation (surveyed 2026-11-18) |
| [`rosetta`](https://github.com/tikoci/rosetta) | [`routeros-muse`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-muse) | package | routeros-muse's package.json depends on @tikoci/rosetta@next (surveyed 2026-11-18) |

A change to a provider's published file is a contract change for each user
below it ([tikoci-data-contracts](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-data-contracts/SKILL.md)).

## House skills by task

Each row is the "Use when" clause of a [house skill](https://tikoci.dev/house/).

| Use when | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| writing or debugging a workflow or waiting on a run | [`tikoci-ci`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-ci/SKILL.md) |
| adding or changing a command, flag, error, tip, library export or MCP tool | [`tikoci-cli-mcp`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-cli-mcp/SKILL.md) |
| designing a dataset, schema, database, extractor or published file | [`tikoci-data-contracts`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-data-contracts/SKILL.md) |
| adding or updating a dependency or action, or answering a bot that asks for a pin | [`tikoci-dependencies`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-dependencies/SKILL.md) |
| adding, moving or naming docs, tracking work, or deciding where something goes | [`tikoci-docs`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-docs/SKILL.md) |
| creating a repo, changing settings or handling an alert | [`tikoci-github`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-github/SKILL.md) |
| debugging, measuring or claiming done | [`tikoci-grounding`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-grounding/SKILL.md) |
| adding a file a tool keeps outside the checkout, an env override, a settings layer, a cache, a cross-tool reference or a test that touches user state | [`tikoci-home`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-home/SKILL.md) |
| creating or editing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .agents/ or a SKILL.md, adopting a house skill, or deciding where a rule belongs | [`tikoci-house`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-house/SKILL.md) |
| adding or configuring a linter, git hook, suppression or dictionary word | [`tikoci-linting`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-linting/SKILL.md) |
| opening, reviewing, answering or merging a PR | [`tikoci-pr-flow`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-pr-flow/SKILL.md) |
| cutting a release or changing versions, the CHANGELOG or a release workflow | [`tikoci-release`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-release/SKILL.md) |
| writing tests, mocks or test tiers | [`tikoci-testing`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-testing/SKILL.md) |
| choosing a runtime, language, script, task runner or dev tool | [`tikoci-toolchain`](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-toolchain/SKILL.md) |

## Org metadata

Collected by tikoci.github.io (hourly; the Pages inventory weekly) and
published at durable URLs:

| URL | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| <https://tikoci.dev/data/repos.json> | Public repos with description, stars, topics and category. |
| <https://tikoci.dev/data/dashboard.json> | Per-repo CI, npm, release and RouterOS version signals, findings, and these relationships with their readiness ([contract](https://tikoci.dev/dashboard-schema.md)). |
| <https://tikoci.dev/metadata/index.json> | Discovery for the independent datasets, such as the GitHub Pages inventory. |
| <https://tikoci.dev/house/index.json> | The house skills and their files. |

## The TIKOCI look

tikoci.dev and restraml's tool pages share Pico v2, JetBrains Mono and
Manrope, and a header with a Tools menu; each site keeps its own copy of the
shared CSS and JS (restraml's are `restraml-shared.css` and `.js`). There is
no shared package yet: copy from tikoci.github.io (`src/shared.css`,
`src/shared.js`, and "Site conventions" in its `AGENTS.md`), and see
[docs/presentation.md](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io/blob/main/docs/presentation.md) for the
planned shared design.
